color.description: The tag's intent, given either as one of the six names or as CSS colors: [label color, background color]: the icon stays white [label color, background color, icon color]

hover.description: Whether the tag responds to the pointer with a darker fill and a pointer cursor. False removes the tag from pointer events altogether, which also keeps a surrounding Tooltip from opening.

onClick.description: MUI's prop. Makes the tag a button: a tab stop that answers Enter and Space.

sdsSize.description: The size of the tag: an 11px label with a 12px icon, or a 13px label with a 24px icon. A large tag has to have an icon.

sdsStyle.description: The shape of the tag. The design guidance treats rounded as the default for the system, so it is usually worth passing.

sdsType.description: primary fills the tag with the intent color and sets the label white. secondary tints the fill and keeps the label and a 1px border in the intent color.
